title: groups_remove skips signature verification when remover pubkey unpinned (fail-open inverse of invite)
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_remove.py:59-64. 'if pubkey is not None and not verify(...)' - absence SKIPS verification while roster.can_remove still authorizes removed_by==owner. Shipped test enshrines b'\x00'*48 signature accepted -> 2.04. Exploit: forge {removed_by:<owner>,signature:junk} forcing own removal repeatedly: members/admins stripped, invitations popped+burned, epoch rotated => repeatable de-enrollment/key-churn DoS + existence oracle. Symmetrize fail-closed like invite bead worker6-nhlj fix.

Added unpinned, unknown-key recovery, mismatched-signature recovery, valid pinned owner, owner self-removal, replay, and concurrent duplicate regressions; updated the existing rekey fixture to use a genuine pinned signature.
